title: May Content Calendar Planning
scope: Plan the May content schedule — Mother's Day, farmers market season, summer grilling preview

messages.content: Let's map out May. I want to keep the 2-3 posts per week cadence. Mother's Day is May 10 — we should have something for that. Farmers market season starts too.

Here's my May framework:

**Week 1 (May 1-4):** Kick off with a "May Menu Kickoff" blog post previewing the month's highlights. Follow with a Farmers Market Guide on Instagram.

**Week 2 (May 5-10):** Mother's Day Brunch Guide (blog) — publish by May 8 so people have time to plan. This is our biggest traffic opportunity of the month.

**Week 3 (May 11-15):** Grilled Salmon Recipe (blog) transitions into summer grilling content. Cookie Baking Reel (Instagram) for a sweet midweek pick-me-up.

I'll build this into a plan with deliverables and lead times for each piece.
That works. Build the plan and make sure Pixel is lined up for the photography.

Plan created: **May Content Calendar** with 6 deliverables across blog and Instagram. Pixel is tagged for all image assets. Lead times are staggered so we're never prepping more than 2 pieces simultaneously.
